deep_dive.summary: milla-jovovich/mempalace is gaining traction with 30,429 stars. The highest-scoring AI memory system ever benchmarked. And it's free.. This represents a significant trend in Python tooling for production systems. FDEs should understand whether this is a flash-in-the-pan or a genuine shift in how teams build AI systems.
deep_dive.fde_takeaway: Evaluate milla-jovovich/mempalace for client relevance. If it solves a real problem, early expertise = premium positioning. If not, you save clients from chasing hype.
